proc-access-lsass:
title: LSASS Access
author: SOC
level: high
logsource:
    product: windows
    category: process_access
detection:
    selection:
        TargetImage|endswith: '\lsass.exe'
        GrantedAccess: '0x1010'
    condition: selection
cred-dump-procdump:
title: Credential Dump with procdump
description: procdump writing a memory dump
logsource:
    product: windows
    category: process_creation
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\procdump.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'lsass'
    condition: selection
mimikatz-commandline:
title: Mimikatz
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'sekurlsa'
            - 'logonpasswords'
    condition: selection
encoded-powershell:
title: Encoded PowerShell
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '-enc'
            - '-EncodedCommand'
    condition: selection
psexec-service:
title: PsExec Service Install
detection:
    selection:
        ServiceName: 'PSEXESVC'
    condition: selection
run-key-persistence:
title: Run Key Persistence
detection:
    selection:
        TargetObject|contains: '\CurrentVersion\Run\'
        Details|contains: '.exe'
    condition: selection
scheduled-task-new:
title: Scheduled Task Created
detection:
    selection:
        EventID: 4698
    filter:
        User: 'SYSTEM'
    condition: selection and not filter
wmi-persistence:
title: WMI Persistence
detection:
    selection:
        EventID: 5861
        Name|contains: 'ActiveScriptEventConsumer'
    condition: selection
lsass-dump-comsvcs:
title: LSASS dump via comsvcs
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'comsvcs.dll'
            - 'MiniDump'
    condition: selection
ntds-dump:
title: NTDS.dit Export
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'ntdsutil'
            - 'ifm'
    condition: selection
kerberoasting:
title: Kerberoasting
detection:
    selection:
        EventID: 4769
        TicketEncryptionType: '0x17'
    filter:
        ServiceName: 'krbtgt'
    condition: selection and not filter
asrep-roasting:
title: AS-REP Roasting
detection:
    selection:
        EventID: 4768
        PreAuthType: '0'
    condition: selection
golden-ticket:
title: Possible Golden Ticket
detection:
    selection:
        EventID: 4624
        LogonType: 3
        AuthenticationPackageName: 'Kerberos'
    filter:
        TargetUserName: 'ANONYMOUS LOGON'
    condition: selection and not filter
pass-the-hash:
title: Pass the Hash
detection:
    selection:
        EventID: 4624
        LogonType: 3
        AuthenticationPackageName: 'NTLM'
    condition: selection
bruteforce-4625:
title: Multiple Failed Logons
detection:
    selection:
        EventID: 4625
    condition: selection | count() by IpAddress > 10
rdp-external:
title: RDP from Internet
detection:
    selection:
        EventID: 4624
        LogonType: 10
    filter:
        IpAddress|startswith:
            - '10.'
            - '192.168.'
    condition: selection and not filter
defender-disabled:
title: Defender Disabled
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'Set-MpPreference'
            - 'DisableRealtimeMonitoring'
    condition: selection
amsi-bypass:
title: AMSI Bypass
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|contains: 'amsiInitFailed'
    condition: selection
uac-bypass-fodhelper:
title: UAC Bypass via fodhelper
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\fodhelper.exe'
    condition: selection
lsass-access-mask:
title: Suspicious LSASS Access Mask
detection:
    selection:
        EventID: 10
        GrantedAccess:
            - '0x1fffff'
            - '0x1410'
            - '0x143a'
    condition: selection
wevtutil-clear:
title: Event Log Cleared
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\wevtutil.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'cl'
    condition: selection
vssadmin-delete:
title: Shadow Copies Deleted
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'delete'
            - 'shadows'
    condition: selection
bcdedit-recovery-off:
title: Recovery Disabled
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'recoveryenabled'
    condition: selection
certutil-download:
title: Certutil Download
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\certutil.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'urlcache'
    condition: selection
bitsadmin-download:
title: Bitsadmin Transfer
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\bitsadmin.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: '/transfer'
    condition: selection
rundll32-js:
title: Rundll32 Script Execution
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'javascript:'
    condition: selection
mshta-remote:
title: Mshta Remote Payload
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\mshta.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'http://'
            - 'https://'
    condition: selection
regsvr32-sct:
title: Regsvr32 Squiblydoo
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\regsvr32.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'scrobj.dll'
    condition: selection
wmic-process-call:
title: Wmic Process Call Create
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'process call create'
    condition: selection
net-user-add:
title: Local User Created
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\net.exe'
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'user'
            - '/add'
    condition: selection
net-group-admin:
title: User Added to Administrators
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\net.exe'
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'localgroup'
            - 'administrators'
            - '/add'
    condition: selection
sc-service-create:
title: Service Created
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\sc.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'create'
    condition: selection
whoami-recon:
title: Recon whoami
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\whoami.exe'
    condition: selection
nltest-recon:
title: Nltest Domain Trust Recon
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\nltest.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: '/domain_trusts'
    condition: selection
dsquery-recon:
title: Dsquery Harvest
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\dsquery.exe'
    condition: selection
adfind-recon:
title: AdFind Execution
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\adfind.exe'
    condition: selection
cobaltstrike-named-pipe:
title: Cobalt Strike Named Pipe
detection:
    selection:
        EventID: 17
        PipeName|startswith: '\msagent_'
    condition: selection
office-child-shell:
title: Office Spawns Shell
detection:
    selection:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '\WINWORD.EXE'
            - '\EXCEL.EXE'
        Image|endswith:
            - '\cmd.exe'
            - '\powershell.exe'
    condition: selection
browser-credential-access:
title: Browser Credential Store Access
detection:
    selection:
        TargetImage|endswith: '\Login Data'
    condition: selection
cloud-s3-public:
title: S3 Bucket Made Public
detection:
    selection:
        eventName: 'PutBucketAcl'
        requestParameters.x-amz-acl: 'public-read'
    condition: selection
cloud-iam-key:
title: IAM Access Key Created
detection:
    selection:
        eventName: 'CreateAccessKey'
    condition: selection
cloud-root-login:
title: Root Account Login
detection:
    selection:
        userIdentity.type: 'Root'
        eventName: 'ConsoleLogin'
    condition: selection
cloud-role-trust:
title: IAM Role Trust Policy Changed
detection:
    selection:
        eventName: 'UpdateAssumeRolePolicy'
    condition: selection
linux-sudo-shadow:
title: Reading Shadow via sudo
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: 'cat'
        CommandLine|contains: '/etc/shadow'
    condition: selection
linux-cron-persist:
title: Cron Persistence
detection:
    selection:
        TargetFilename|startswith: '/etc/cron'
    condition: selection
linux-ssh-authorized-keys:
title: Authorized Keys Modified
detection:
    selection:
        TargetFilename|endswith: '/.ssh/authorized_keys'
    condition: selection
linux-reverse-shell:
title: Reverse Shell
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'bash -i'
            - '/dev/tcp/'
    condition: selection
dns-tunneling:
title: Possible DNS Tunneling
detection:
    selection:
        QueryName|endswith: '.example.com'
    condition: selection
rare-process-name:
title: Suspicious Temp Exec
detection:
    selection:
        Image|startswith:
            - 'C:\Users\'
            - 'C:\ProgramData\'
        Image|endswith: '.exe'
    filter:
        Image|contains: '\AppData\Local\Microsoft\'
    condition: selection and not filter
two-selection-and:
title: Two Selections Both Required
detection:
    sel1:
        EventID: 4624
    sel2:
        LogonType: 3
    condition: sel1 and sel2
